picks.title: I connected my local LLM to Gmail, Calendar, and Home Assistant, and it finally became useful
picks.excerpt: It can now actually be productive.
picks.rationale: Hands-on recipe for wiring a self-hosted LLM into mail, calendar and smart-home control. Readers can copy the on-device AI setup tomorrow.

picks.title: Siri can index more of your personal data —  here's how to limit it
picks.excerpt: If you’re concerned about Apple’s new digital assistant, here’s how you can restrict its access to your data.
picks.rationale: Practical privacy controls for the new on-device Siri AI personal-data index. A settings change every iPhone owner can make right away.

picks.title: My brief romance with an AI bird feeder
picks.excerpt: Tits, pigeons, and mice, oh my!
picks.rationale: Fresh real-world test of an AI species-recognition camera gadget that shows where consumer vision AI helps and where it falls short.

picks.title: I tested MSI's Pro Max Edge AI+ mini PC and its offline AI is off the charts
picks.excerpt: The MSI Pro Max Edge AI+ is a mini PC with a difference. Built for local AI, it features the AMD’s Ryzen AI Max+ 395, Radeon 8060s graphics and a 50-TOPS NPU.
picks.rationale: Review of a different local-AI mini PC (MSI, Ryzen AI Max+ 395, 50-TOPS NPU) with offline inference results. Useful for anyone sizing hardware for on-device models.

picks.title: Amazon drivers are getting AI smart glasses — but my warehouse tour reveals their 1-million strong automated robot workforce is the real story
picks.excerpt: The glasses aren't what we should be worried about
picks.rationale: On-the-ground look at AI smart glasses deployed to delivery drivers alongside warehouse robots. Wearable AI used at work rather than as a consumer demo.
